body: POST /api/v1/emily/run { command: string, timeout: int } added to emily-agent HTTP server. Whitelisted subcommands: observe, obs, apples, status, sync, backlog, primetask, agents, watch. Shell-splits command string (single-quote aware), execs emily binary with timeout (default 60s, max 300s). Returns exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration JSON. Route wired in main.go. Tests: splitArgs, whitelist block, method check, empty command check — all pass.
title: S13 emily prime API parity — POST /api/v1/emily/run endpoint added
